obfuscation_indicators: not possible to predict all risks
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified regarding liquidity, debt maturities, cash flows, capital expenditures, and regulatory commitments, but is preceded and supplemented by extensive standard forward-looking-statement disclaimers. Management expresses near-term liquidity confidence while acknowledging pressure from customer losses, competition, declining access revenues, economic conditions, financing-counterparty risk, and sizable debt maturities.
